name: Wooden Pen Holder With Clock
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering a natural, elegant, and practical desktop design.
    - Functions as both a pen holder and a digital clock, combining organization with everyday convenience.
    - Built with a smooth wooden body that adds a warm and modern touch to desks, study tables, and office spaces.
    - Features a built-in LED clock display for a clean and easy-to-read appearance.
    - Features a multi-function display mode that supports:
            +) Time display
            +) Temperature display
            +) Date display
    - Designed with dual power options, allowing use with either a USB cable or batteries.
    - Available in 3 color variations: Brown, Bamboo, Black.
    📌 Note: Batteries not included.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Product size: 6.1 x 13.7 cm ~ 2.4 x 5.4 in.
    📌 Note:  The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a wooden pen holder and a digital desk clock.
    - Designed to help organize pens, pencils, markers, rulers, and other desk essentials while also displaying time, date, and temperature.
    - Suitable for desks, offices, classrooms, bedside tables, and study spaces.
    - Helps keep the workspace neat while adding a decorative and personalized touch.
    - A great combination of practical storage and everyday display function.
    - Perfect for both personal use and gift giving.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for teachers, coworkers, students, parents, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Teacher Appreciation Day, birthdays, back-to-school gifts, office gifts, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves practical desk accessories with a personal touch.
    - Great for classroom desks, office workstations, study tables, and home organization.
    - A useful and meaningful gift that combines decoration, storage, and daily function.
    - Adds a warm, neat, and memorable touch to any desk🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 xWooden Pen Holder With Clock

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
